### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Workspace-manager sign-in is granted in muster](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3142) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Workspaces work with workspace-manager 0.10, which moved a person's provider sign-in to muster: the portal reads the manager's new sign-in instructions and no longer calls its removed connect and disconnect tools.
